notes: Knowledge Tags represent earned working understanding of materials, techniques, and magical structures.
Tags are never purchased with XP — earned through gathering, crafting, training, and discovery.
Three domains: material (substance knowledge), technique (process knowledge), formula (spell logic).
Five tiers: T1=common, T2=uncommon, T3=rare, T4=epic, T5=world-unique.
tag_id values must match knowledge_tags_earned in Gatherables.json and required_tags in CraftRecipes.json.
Skill level bridges missing tags: 10% per level (max 50% at L5). Full tags still required for legendary recipes.

iron_working.name: Iron Working
iron_working.description: Grain structure, heat behavior, carbon content, corrosion patterns, and optimal forging temperatures for iron.
how_gained: Complete a smithing recipe using iron

metalworking.name: Metalworking
metalworking.description: General metal properties — ductility, hardness, conductivity, and smelting requirements across common metals (copper, lead, bronze).

woodworking.name: Woodworking
woodworking.description: Timber species, grain direction, moisture content, splitting tendencies, and best uses of common and uncommon woods.
how_gained: Gather oak, ash, or yew wood

fletching.name: Fletching
fletching.description: Arrow shaft selection, feather vane properties, spine flex, and tip attachment materials for different projectile applications.
how_gained: Gather ash or yew wood for shafts

textile_working.name: Textile Working
textile_working.description: Plant fiber properties — linen, cotton, and reed: thread count, weave density, tear resistance, and dye absorption.
how_gained: Complete a weaving or tailoring recipe

wool_working.name: Wool Working
wool_working.description: Wool fiber properties: crimp structure, felting behavior, lanolin content, washing requirements, and spinning for yarn production.
how_gained: Complete a weaving recipe using wool

leatherworking.name: Leatherworking
leatherworking.description: Hide grades, tanning methods (bark vs. mineral), thickness, moisture resistance, and tooling surface quality.

tanning.name: Tanning
tanning.description: The hide curing and tanning process — bark tannin ratios, salt curing, de-hairing, and fat-liquoring for supple finished leather.
how_gained: Complete a leatherworking recipe that includes tanning

bonecraft.name: Bonecraft
bonecraft.description: Bone density, stress fracture lines, chitin plate structure, and shell lamination — how to work each material without cracking.
how_gained: Gather beast bone, insect chitin, or crab shell

glassblowing.name: Glassblowing
glassblowing.description: Glass composition, melting temperature, gather viscosity, annealing rates, and the properties of clear vs. colored glass.
how_gained: Gather glass sand or quartz sand

gem_crafting.name: Gem Crafting
gem_crafting.description: Gem hardness scales, cleavage planes, inclusion types, and the relationship between cut quality and optical properties.
how_gained: Mine or gather quartz or rock crystal

crystallography.name: Crystallography
crystallography.description: Mana-conducting crystal lattice structures — which crystal types hold charges, resonance frequencies, and optimal cut geometries for arcane focus.

masonry.name: Masonry
masonry.description: Stone load-bearing capacity, mortar mix ratios, keystone arch mechanics, and which stone types cut clean vs. rough.

meteorics.name: Meteorics
meteorics.description: Meteoric iron and primal ore properties — unique crystalline matrix, inherent elemental charge, resistance to standard forging, and ritual quench requirements.

silk_working.name: Silk Working
silk_working.description: Sea silk and spider silk properties — tensile strength, water resistance, magical conductivity, and specialized tools needed to work them without damage.
how_gained: Gather sea silk or spider silk
Complete a tailoring or weaving recipe using silk

exotic_tanning.name: Exotic Tanning
exotic_tanning.description: Processing magical creature hides — drakehide flame-resistance treatment, shadowhide umbral preservation, and the alchemical baths required to prevent magical decay.
how_gained: Complete a leatherworking recipe using exotic hides

alloy_tempering.name: Alloy Tempering
alloy_tempering.description: Alloy compositions — steel carbon ratios, bronze tin percentages, brass zinc content — and the tempering cycles that produce target hardness/ductility profiles.
how_gained: Complete an advanced smithing recipe producing steel or bronze

apothecary.name: Apothecary
apothecary.description: Medicinal herb identification, preparation methods (infusion vs. decoction vs. poultice), dosage ranges, and known interactions.
how_gained: Gather wyrmroot bark, bloodvine, or common herbs

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.description: Reagent properties, solubility, volatility, exothermic reactions, and safe mixing orders for common alchemical compounds.

enchanting.name: Enchanting
enchanting.description: Arcane material interaction — which base materials accept enchantments, how to identify enchantable items, and the mana bleed patterns of improperly bound enchantments.

umbrawork.name: Umbrawork
umbrawork.description: Shadow energy material properties — umbral absorption rates in different materials, decay patterns in light, and which materials best anchor shadow infusion.

exotic_crafting.name: Exotic Crafting
exotic_crafting.description: Working with rare creature components — dragon bone grain direction, scaled-material tooling, and the preservation rituals needed to prevent magical decay during construction.
how_gained: Complete a beastcraft recipe using T4 materials

smithing.name: Smithing
smithing.description: Hammer, anvil, and heat cycle — proper striking angles, quench timing, scale removal, and working temperature recognition.
how_gained: Complete a smithing recipe at L1

weaving.name: Weaving
weaving.description: Loom operation, shuttle passing, warp tension management, and pattern threading for plain, twill, and satin weaves.

edge_geometry.name: Edge Geometry
edge_geometry.description: Blade angle theory — convex vs. flat vs. hollow grinds, cutting applications, sharpening progressions, and the relationship between edge angle and material.
how_gained: Complete a smithing recipe of uncommon tier or higher

distillation.name: Distillation
distillation.description: Alembic operation, temperature graduation, fraction collection, and reflux technique for purifying reagents and concentrating active compounds.
how_gained: Complete an alchemy or apothecary recipe

thermal_infusion.name: Thermal Infusion
thermal_infusion.description: Applying magical energy through heat — the temperature windows and quench fluids that allow a spell-effect to bond to metal or crystal during the cooling phase.
how_gained: Complete an enchanting or meteorics recipe

runic_inscription.name: Runic Inscription
runic_inscription.description: The physical act of rune drawing — ink viscosity per surface, stroke order, line continuity, and breath control needed to maintain stable magical current during inscription.
how_gained: Complete a runesmith or runic scribing recipe

sympathetic_resonance.name: Sympathetic Resonance
sympathetic_resonance.description: Creating a magical link between two items so effects applied to one transfer to the other — requires compatible material base and matching rune anchors.
how_gained: Complete a rare-tier enchanting or crystallography recipe

combustion_logic.name: Combustion Logic
combustion_logic.description: Spell-logic structure underlying fire-type effects — oxidation trigger chains, heat concentration geometry, and the termination anchor that prevents runaway burn.
how_gained: Pyromancy Affinity Style L2 or higher

elemental_binding.name: Elemental Binding
elemental_binding.description: Formula structure for locking an elemental force into a physical container — binding nodes, force directionality, and the containment seal that holds the element without suppressing it.
how_gained: Complete an enchanting or crystallography recipe with elemental focus

planar_binding_structure.name: Planar Binding Structure
planar_binding_structure.description: Multi-layered formula for anchoring an entity from another plane — dimensional tethering logic, counter-resonance buffer, and fail-safe collapse that releases the entity safely if the seal breaks.
how_gained: Complete a binding & sealing recipe of rare tier

planar_ignition.name: Planar Ignition
planar_ignition.description: Cross-planar energy formulas that pull destructive force from an adjacent plane — requires a stable planar window and channeling lattice to prevent blowback.
how_gained: Discover in dungeon or boss-tier content

temporal_loop.name: Temporal Loop
temporal_loop.description: Self-referencing time formula creating a local pocket of repeating duration — used in legendary item construction to give items a reset state or lingering repeat effect.
how_gained: World-unique discovery — specific content encounter required

celestial_formula_structure.name: Celestial Formula Structure
celestial_formula_structure.description: Divine or celestial magic formula framework — harmonic alignment patterns, purification logic, and the resonance architecture used in holy weapons and sacred ward construction.
how_gained: Sacred text deconstruction at bookbinding L4+

aetheric_core_inscription.name: Aetheric Core Inscription
aetheric_core_inscription.description: Core-level formula forming the heart of a legendary arcane construct — defines autonomous power routing, self-repair logic, and the soul-compatible interface layer.
how_gained: World-unique. Found only in lost ruins, ancient construct remains, or defeated Tier 5 artificial beings.
